tensura.skill.abnormal_condition_nullifi:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Completely negate all abnormal conditions and their effects.
tensura.skill.abnormal_condition_resista:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Resist the effects of weaker abnormal conditions or reduce the severity of stronger ones.
tensura.skill.absolute_severance.descrip:
Severing melee coat or flying slash.
§6Severance Coat§r §epress§r: Severance Blade V (XX mastered) for 600s; again to remove.
§6Severance Cutter§r §epress§r: 50 damage (300 mastered), size 5 (8 mastered). 20,000 magicule.
tensura.skill.acid_rain.description:
Acid cloud rains corrosion: 40 damage in a 7.5-block radius (10 mastered) for 20s.
§eHold 4s, release§r: cast where you aim, up to 20 blocks.
tensura.skill.acid_shell.description:
Acid ball: 175 damage and 300 armor durability damage. Mastered: adds Corrosion II for 20s. Costs 38,000 magicule.
§eHold 4s, release§r to fire.
tensura.skill.aerial_blade.description:
§eHold§r to cast, then release.
§7Pull in any nearby entities before dealing massive damage by unleashing the power of your spirit.
tensura.skill.agility.description:
Speed III and Haste III for 120s (600 mastered). Costs 3,000 magicule.
§eHold 5s, release§r: buff yourself.
§eSneak+release§r: buff the target you aim at within 10 blocks instead.
tensura.skill.air_flight.description:
Fly where you look; release in midair to hover.
§ePress§r: stop falling.
§eHold§r: fly forward.
§eSneak+release§r: fall normally.
§eScroll§r (mastered): move up/down.
tensura.skill.airflow_shut.description:
Airless sphere suffocates targets and applies Silence I for 5s. Lasts 10s.
§eHold 5s§r at a target within 20 blocks; keep holding to sustain, 1,300 magicule/s.
§6Expanded§r (mastered): larger sphere.
tensura.skill.all_seeing_eye.description:
Third-person view with faster attacks, movement, swimming and mining, dodge chance and stronger Presence Sense.
§ePress§r to use; toggles once mastered.
tensura.skill.analyst.description:
Toggle: faster chanting, thinking and skill learning/mastery.
§6Analytical Appraisal§r §epress§r: scan 20 blocks (25 mastered). §eSneak+press§r: entities/blocks/both.
§6Analyze§r §ehold§r at a copiable magic projectile within 30 blocks: learn its spell after 5s (3s mastered; chant speed helps).
tensura.skill.analytical_appraisal.descr:
Shows the EP and stats of what you look at.
§ePress§r at a target. §eSneak+press§r: analyse entities, blocks or both.
Mastered: also scans 5 blocks around you.
tensura.skill.analyze.description:
Raises analysis by 1 level and 5 blocks range (2 levels and 10 blocks mastered), revealing target stats.
§eHold 2s§r, then keep holding to analyse; §erelease§r to stop.
tensura.skill.anti_magic_area.descriptio:
Blocks Aspectual and Summoning Magic in a 10-block radius (25 mastered) for 60s. Costs 20,000 magicule.
§eHold 11s, release§r: create zone.
§eSneak+press§r looking at your zone: remove it.
tensura.skill.anti_shock_area.descriptio:
Reduces physical damage inside a 7.5-block radius for 120s (15 blocks, 180s mastered). Costs 15,000 magicule.
§eHold 11s, release§r: create zone.
§eSneak+press§r looking at your zone: remove it.
tensura.skill.anti_skill.description:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Become immune to damage from Magic, Skills and Battlewill, destroy barriers and block skill usage of other entities.
tensura.skill.antidote.description:
Removes Nausea, Poison and Weakness; mastered also weakens Fatal Poison. Costs 2,500 magicule.
§eHold 6s, release§r at a target within 6 blocks, or aim away to treat yourself.
tensura.skill.aura_shield.description:
A barrier of aura in front of you that absorbs hits (100 HP). Costs 1,000 aura.
§eHold§r to keep it up.
tensura.skill.aura_slash.description:
Ranged slash: ×1 weapon damage (×2 mastered). Needs a sword or axe. 50 aura.
§ePress§r: fire; mastered fires from both hands if both hold weapons.
tensura.skill.aura_sword.description:
Adds +100% weapon damage to direct physical hits for 60s. 200 aura.
§ePress§r: apply or remove.
Mastered: §etoggle§r to sustain, draining aura.
tensura.skill.barrier.description:
Physical protection for 10s (20 mastered): blocks small hits and subtracts damage from larger ones, scaled to health when cast. Costs 5% of base max magicule, minimum 2,000.
§eHold 8s, release§r.
tensura.skill.battlewill.description:
Converts magicules to aura at 1:1, using 1% of your max magicules every 1.5s (2% mastered).
§eHold§r: convert until your aura is full.
tensura.skill.beast_transformation.descr:
Full heal and energy refill; +15 attack, +10 armor, faster movement and ×2 energy capacity for 180s (360 mastered). Ending gives Weakness II, Fragility II and Paralysis for 600s.
§ePress§r: transform or end early. Cooldown 60s.
tensura.skill.berserk.description:
Toggle: ×2 fire boost; melee hits burn foes.
§6Rage§r §epress§r: Strengthen V (X mastered) for 300s; again to end.
§6Mad Ogre§r §epress§r: transform for 600s, 5,000 magicule; Rampage for 30s. Mastered: press again to fire/summon orbs (100 damage).
§eSneak+press§r: end form. Mastered: §esneak§r to spend an orb and halve a hit.
tensura.skill.berserker.description:
Armor, attack and speed scale with EP; mastered attack bonus doubles. Damages enemy equipment faster. Toggle boosts EP gains.
§eHold 2s§r: transform.
§eHold again§r: end transformation.
tensura.skill.bewilder.description:
Mind-controls eligible non-spiritual foes.
§6Target§r §epress§r: control for 600s; §esneak+press§r: release.
§6Area§r §epress§r: control within 10 blocks (15 mastered) for 300s. Resistance halves control time.
§6Charm§r §epress§r: Hero of the Village V for 120s.
§6Kill§r §epress§r: controlled foes nearby take their current HP as damage (half if resistant).
tensura.skill.black_flame.description:
Black flames and explosive shots.
§eToggle§r: hits inflict Black Burn for 10s.
§6Flame Breath§r §ehold§r: 9 fire + 1 magic damage (18 + 2 mastered).
§6Fireball§r §epress§r: 45 fire + 5 magic.
§6Hell Flare§r §epress§r: 270 + 30, radius 15.
§6Limited Hell Flare§r §epress§r: 720 + 80, radius 2.5. Both flares cost 2,000 magicule.
tensura.skill.black_lightning.descriptio:
Lightning + magic damage; aim up to 50 blocks.
§ePress§r for bolts:
§6Default Power§r: 45 + 5 damage, radius 8.
§6Decreased Power§r: 22.5 + 2.5, radius 5.
§6Increased Power§r: 135 + 15, radius 12.
§6Blast§r §ehold§r: 22.5 + 2.5 beam, range 30.
§6Death Storm§r §epress§r: bolts and tornadoes within 30; 5,000 magicule. Again to stop.
tensura.skill.blizzard.description:
Ice storm around you: 15-block radius for 100s (160 mastered). Enemies take 30 damage and Chill; giant icicles (250 damage) fall every 10s. 50,000 magicule.
§eHold 8s, release§r: cast. §eSneak+press§r: end it.
tensura.skill.blood_mist.description:
Life-stealing mist; costs 20 HP to summon.
§6Default§r §epress§r: place a 5-block mist within 10; press again: explode for 100 damage.
§6Blood Ray§r §ehold§r: 40-block beam, 50 damage; costs 10 HP per 0.5s and 10,000 magicule. Requires mastery and 500,000 EP.
tensura.skill.body_armor.description:
Summons Armorsaurus armor into empty armor slots. 50 magicule.
§ePress§r: equip; with all slots filled, removes summoned pieces.
§eSneak+press§r: summon a gauntlet in an empty main hand, or remove it.
tensura.skill.body_double.description:
A fighting clone using 10% of your maximum magicule.
§6Clone Creation§r §epress§r: summon.
§6Clone Control§r §epress§r at your clone within 50: swap bodies; leaves your original still and gives Fragility II and Energy Blockade V. Stay within 50 of your original or take damage.
§eSneak+press§r in Control: dismiss a moving clone.
tensura.skill.burden.description:
Gravity projectile applies Burden III and Slowness II for 30s, making targets heavy and slow.
§eHold 4s, release§r to fire.
tensura.skill.chain_explosion.descriptio:
3 chained blasts: 200 damage each in a 10-block radius (300 damage, 15 blocks mastered), 1.5s apart. Costs 80,000 magicule.
§eHold 7s, release§r at a spot within 32 blocks.
tensura.skill.chant_annulment.descriptio:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Become able to cast mastered magic instantly, in water or even under the effects of silence.
tensura.skill.charm.description:
Charms a target within 5 blocks: EP ≤25% of yours gives control for 300s (600 mastered); ≤50% makes it neutral. Spiritual resistance lowers these limits. Cost: target EP +80 magicule.
§ePress§r at a target.
§eSneak+press§r: undo your charm.
tensura.skill.chef.description:
Heals missing HP, clears severance damage and removes harmful effects except skill effects. Costs 60 magicule per HP (40 mastered), 100 per effect.
§ePress§r: heal yourself.
§eSneak+press§r: heal a target within 5 blocks.
tensura.skill.chosen_one.description:
Toggle: Hero of the Village V. Equipped: Luck V and buffs to allies within 15 blocks.
§6Hero's Haki§r §ehold§r: fear aura.
§6Hero's Charisma§r §epress§r: control eligible foes within 10 blocks for 120s (60s if resistant).
§eScroll§r (mastered): Power Scale.
tensura.skill.clairvoyance.description:
Zooms your view while held.
§eHold 1s§r, then keep holding to look; §erelease§r to stop.
§eScroll§r: zoom (limit 50; 25 mastered).
tensura.skill.coercion.description:
A roar ahead of you (14 blocks) that gives weaker foes Fear and Weakness.
§ePress§r to roar. §eScroll§r (mastered): Power Scale.
tensura.skill.cold_resistance.descriptio:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Ignore weak cold damage or resist the damage of powerful attacks.
tensura.skill.commander.description:
§bPassive§r: followers within 30 blocks get +30% stats and 30% crit chance.
§6Communication§r modes: §epress§r at a follower to set it to follow/stay or attack. §eSneak§r for all followers.
§6Thought Domination§r: effect not checked.
tensura.skill.confusion.description:
Confuses foes within 10 blocks for 15s (20 mastered), up to level III (IV mastered). Fails above ×1.5 your EP. Costs 2,000 magicule.
§eHold 5s, release§r.
tensura.skill.cook.description:
Toggle: +100% crit and dodge-negation chance; faster skill learning/mastery. Hits can break multilayer barriers.
§6Chaotic Fate§r §epress§r: arm max-HP reduction on your next hit; stays active when mastered.
§eSneak+press§r: restore a target's lost max HP within 6 blocks.
tensura.skill.corrosion.description:
Your hits apply Corrosion and Wither for 10s.
§ePress§r to coat your attacks; toggles once mastered.
tensura.skill.corrosion_nullification.de:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Completely negate all corrosion damage.
tensura.skill.corrosion_resistance.descr:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Ignore weak corrosive effects or reduce the damage from stronger corrosive attacks.
tensura.skill.create_greater_undead.desc:
§eHold§r to cast, then release.
§6Modes§r: Zombie, Skeleton, Random Undead.
§7Call forth armed undead from the ground to aid the caster.
tensura.skill.create_lesser_undead.descr:
§eHold§r to cast, then release.
§6Modes§r: Zombie, Skeleton, Random Undead.
§7Call forth weak undead from the ground to aid the caster.
tensura.skill.creator.description:
Creates temporary Unique skills from the configured list.
§6Analytical Appraisal§r §epress§r: inspect targets; mastered scans 5 blocks. §eSneak+press§r: entities/blocks/both.
§6Skill Creation§r §epress§r: open skill creation menu; skill lasts 60s, 60s cooldown.
tensura.skill.curse.description:
§eHold§r to cast, then release.
§7Release Miasmic Mist to curse targets.
tensura.skill.curse_bind.description:
§eHold§r to cast, then release.
§7Call forth spirits of the death to bind and corrode targets.
tensura.skill.danger_sense.description:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Receive a mental warning when entities with hostile intent enter your proximity.
tensura.skill.dark_cube.description:
§eHold§r to cast, then release.
§7Create a cube of darkness that slows movement and deals constant damage.
tensura.skill.dark_eight_palms.descripti:
Fires 1–8 aura spheres at your aim: 100 damage each, 3-block blasts. 200 aura per sphere.
§eHold at least 1s (0.5s mastered), release§r. Longer hold adds spheres.
tensura.skill.darkness.description:
§eHold§r to cast, then release.
§7Call on your spirit to reduce the enemy's vision in a wide area.
tensura.skill.darkness_attack_nullificat:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Completely nullify all darkness damage.
tensura.skill.darkness_attack_resistance:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Ignore weaker darkness damage or reduce the damage of stronger attacks.
tensura.skill.darkness_cannon.descriptio:
§eHold§r to cast, then release.
§7Shoot a long beam which deals massive damage, destroys armor and debilitates enemies.
tensura.skill.darkness_transform.descrip:
Dark aura damages nearby enemies and gives Darkness. You move slower while active.
§eHold§r to keep it up.
tensura.skill.death_march_dance.descript:
A swarm of homing aura spheres: 25 damage each, 4-block blasts. Targets within 50 blocks.
§eHold§r to grow the sphere, then §erelease§r to fire. Longer holds spend more aura for more shots.
tensura.skill.degenerate.description:
Craft/decraft items; absorb weakened spirits and steal skills.
§6Crafting§r §epress§r: decrafting menu; §esneak+press§r: item/enchantment synthesis menu.
§6Synthesise§r §epress§r: absorb a spirit below 25% HP or a Charybdis core.
§6Separate§r §epress§r: strip eligible skills, cleanse effects or extract ores; aim at air to cleanse yourself.
tensura.skill.demon_dominate.description:
Control a foe below 200,000 EP (100,000 if resistant) for 600s; permanent when mastered. 100,000 magicule.
§eHold 5s, release§r: target within 10 blocks.
§eSneak+press§r: free your controlled target.
tensura.skill.demon_lord_haki.descriptio:
Stronger Haki: Fear builds twice as fast.
§6Release§r §ehold§r: aura on. §6Coat§r §epress§r: Haki Coat buff for 2 min.
§eScroll§r (mastered): Power Scale.
tensura.skill.demon_marionette.descripti:
Bind and control a foe below 400,000 EP (800,000 mastered); resistant targets have half that limit. Control lasts 600s; permanent mastered. 200,000 magicule.
§eHold 10s, release§r: target within 20 blocks.
§eSneak+press§r: free your controlled target.
tensura.skill.diamond_path.description:
+10 armor and +40% knockback resistance; clears Chill. Lasts 60s; mastered: +20 armor, +80% for 180s.
§ePress§r: apply.
§eToggle§r (mastered): sustain base bonuses, draining aura.
tensura.skill.dimension_cutter.descripti:
Fires a blade of space: 50 damage (100 mastered), size 2 (4 mastered). 20,000 magicule.
§eHold 6s, release§r.
tensura.skill.divine_berserker.descripti:
Ogre Berserker transformation for 180s (360s mastered); Battlewill damage ×1.5 (×2 mastered), with debuffs afterward. Costs 10,000 magicule.
§ePress§r: transform; again to end early.
tensura.skill.divine_ki_release.descript:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Use your Divine Ki to amplify your battlewill to deal more damage and destroy weaker equipment.
tensura.skill.dominate.description:
Control a foe below 10,000 EP (5,000 if resistant) for 600s; permanent when mastered. 10,000 magicule.
§eHold 5s, release§r: target within 6 blocks.
§eSneak+press§r: free your controlled target.
tensura.skill.doppelganger.description:
Creates 2 clones, sharing 10% of your magicule capacity.
§eHold 5s (4s mastered), release§r.
§eSneak+release§r (mastered): 4 clones instead.
§eSneak+press§r at your clone within 30 blocks: dismiss it.
tensura.skill.dragon_ear.description:
Sound-based creature sensing; extends Presence Sense by 30 blocks. No magicule cost.
§eHold§r to listen; toggleable once mastered.
tensura.skill.dragon_eye.description:
Zooms your view and analyses targets up to 100 blocks away.
§eHold§r to look; §erelease§r to stop.
§eSneak+press§r: analyse entities, blocks or both.
§eScroll§r: zoom, up to 50.
tensura.skill.dragon_mode.description:
Doubles magicule and aura capacity; +12 attack damage, +20 armor and faster movement for 180s (360 mastered). Weakness II, Fragility II and Paralysis for 600s afterward.
§ePress§r. Cooldown 60s.
tensura.skill.dragon_skin.description:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Transform your skin into scales which become tougher as you gain more EP.
tensura.skill.drain.description:
Steals 6 health from a foe within 3 blocks and briefly turns this skill into one of theirs (4s).
§ePress§r at the target.
tensura.skill.drainage.description:
Removes nearby water, water plants and waterlogging: 5-block radius (8 mastered), 20 magicule per block.
§eHold 2s, release§r: drain once; keep §eholding§r to drain as you move.
tensura.skill.earth.description:
Places a block that matches the ground around you (dirt, sand, stone, netherrack or end stone).
§eHold briefly, release§r.
tensura.skill.earth_attack_nullification:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Completely nullify all earth damage.
tensura.skill.earth_attack_resistance.de:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Ignore weak earth-based damage or resist the damage from powerful attacks.
tensura.skill.earth_domination.descripti:
Earth abilities ×3 while toggled.
§6Earth Wall§r §epress§r: raise a 4-high wall for 60s.
§6Blocks Break§r §epress§r: break earth blocks within 5 blocks.
§6Earth Pit§r §epress§r: dig beneath you, radius 2, depth 5.
§eToggle§r: boost on/off.
tensura.skill.earth_jail.description:
Encases one target in a mud-brick jail: 50 damage, then heavy Slowness, Mining Fatigue, Burden and Fragility for 60s.
§eHold 7s, release§r at a target within 20 blocks (30 mastered).
tensura.skill.earth_lock.description:
§eHold 2s, release§r.
§6Earth Lock§r: hardens loose ground (dirt, gravel, mud) where you aim, up to 10 blocks away.
§6Self-lock§r: you resist knockback for 12s.
tensura.skill.earth_manipulation.descrip:
§bPassive§r: earth abilities +50%.
§6Wall§r §epress§r: raise a 4-high earth wall.
§6Break§r §epress§r: break the block you aim at.
§6Pit§r §epress§r: open a pit.
tensura.skill.earth_spikes.description:
Dripstone spikes burst up under your target: 30 damage.
§eHold 2s, release§r at a spot within 20 blocks.
tensura.skill.earth_storm.description:
Sandstorm with falling rocks around you: 5-block radius, 20 damage, may lift foes. Lasts 15s (30 mastered).
§eHold 6s, release§r.
tensura.skill.earth_transform.descriptio:
Merge with earth: everything within 5 blocks takes 2 damage a second and gets Burden (heavy) for 8s. You move slower meanwhile. The dust is the visual.
§eHold§r to keep it up.
tensura.skill.earth_wall.description:
Raises a wall of the targeted ground material for 60s, up to 20 blocks away.
§eHold 2s (1s mastered), release§r.
§65x5x1 Wall§r: normal size.
Mastered: §65x5x2 Wall§r, §65x5x3 Wall§r add thickness; §610x10x1 Wall§r doubles width and height.
tensura.skill.earthshatter_kick.descript:
Stomp hits grounded creatures within 5 blocks for 10 damage (20 mastered), knocking them back and upheaving earth. 150 aura.
§ePress§r on dry ground.
tensura.skill.eight_petals_flash.descrip:
20-block dash: attack damage +200; 8 petals block ordinary direct hits for 60s. 10,000 aura. Needs a blade.
§eHold 4s, release§r.
Mastered: up to 8s extra charge, +50 damage/+2,500 aura per second; §epress/release§r again spends 4 petals to dash.
§eSneak+hold§r: dismiss petals.
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Completely nullify all electricity damage.
tensura.skill.electricity_resistance.des:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Ignore weak electrical damage or resist the damage from stronger attacks.
tensura.skill.electro_blast.description:
§eHold§r to cast, then release.
§7Fire a beam attack that pierces through enemies and deals devastating damage while paralyzing your enemies.
tensura.skill.elephant_stampede.descript:
Fires a ring of 8 aura spheres around you, 25 damage each. 100 aura.
§eHold 1s§r.
tensura.skill.engorger.description:
Toggle: grow ×1.5, +10 armor/attack and +2.5 reach.
§ePress§r: Engorgement II for 120s; further presses dash with attack damage +50 (+100 mastered), from ground or water.
§eSneak+press§r: also enables the skill if off.
tensura.skill.envy.description:
Toggle: +10% melee/projectile dodge; blocks Weakness and Slowness.
§6Absorb§r §epress§r: steal EP from an eligible weaker target within 5 blocks; can fail.
§6Strength Sap§r §ehold§r: Slowness/Weakness for 10s and EP drain within 15 blocks; risks Insanity.
tensura.skill.escape.description:
Return to a saved point within 500 blocks (1,000 mastered), same dimension.
§eHold 5s, release§r: save here; cast again to return (§epress§r when mastered).
§eSneak+press§r: clear point.
§eToggle§r (mastered): auto-return at ≤10% HP or <1% magicule.
tensura.skill.explosion.description:
Charged blast: 100 damage and 5-block size per level; cost rises with charge.
§6Explosion Strike§r §ehold 7.5–12.5s (25s max mastered), release§r: strike under open sky. §eSneak+release§r: cancel.
§6Explosion Trap§r (mastered) §ehold 2.5–7.5s, release§r: lay mine within 20 blocks.
§ePress§r at your mine: detonate; §esneak+press§r: remove.
tensura.skill.eye_of_truth.description:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7By obtaining the mythical Hero Egg, the veil of deception is torn apart. No illusion or concealment can deceive your sight, and your vision becomes perfect.
tensura.skill.falsifier.description:
Conceals you and makes illusions.
§6Presence Concealment§r §epress§r: hide for 120s; again to end.
§6Illusion§r §epress§r: open item-illusion menu.
§6Fake Death§r §ehold§r (up to 30s): on a normal hit, leave a decoy corpse and hide for 3s.
tensura.skill.farsight.description:
Zoom your view to see far away.
§eHold§r to look. §eScroll§r: zoom distance.
tensura.skill.fighter.description:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Achieve mastery through discipline. Learn combat and magic abilities instantly, gain more mastery points, and hit much harder.
tensura.skill.fire.description:
A short burst of flame (6 blocks) that lights things on fire. 10 magicule.
§eHold briefly, release§r.
tensura.skill.fire_ball.description:
Exploding fireball: 100 damage plus 30 fire, 3-block blast. 30,000 magicule.
§eHold 3s (1s mastered), release§r.
tensura.skill.fire_bolt.description:
A flaming bolt: 40 damage, burns for 3s.
§eHold 2s (1s mastered), release§r.
tensura.skill.fire_breath.description:
Breathe flames ahead: 15 damage (30 mastered).
§eHold§r to breathe.
tensura.skill.fire_lance.description:
Fiery lances: 50 damage plus 20 fire each.
§6Single§r §ehold 2.5s, release§r: one lance.
§6Repeat§r keep §eholding§r: a lance every 0.5s.
tensura.skill.fire_storm.description:
Fire storm; 10,000 magicule.
§eHold 5s, release§r.
§6Spread§r: around you for 7.5s; 20 magic +30 fire per 0.5s, surges of 200 +50 fire per 1.5s.
§6Condensed§r (mastered): target within 20 blocks; 300 magic +100 fire per 1s.
tensura.skill.fire_wall.description:
Fire wall, 4 wide and 8 high: knocks foes back, 30 magic +10 fire damage per 0.5s (0.25s mastered). Lasts 10s (15s mastered). 5,000 magicule.
§eHold 3s, release§r: place within 10 blocks.
tensura.skill.five_petals_thrust.descrip:
15-block dash: attack damage +100; 5 petals block ordinary direct hits for 60s. 8,000 aura. Needs a blade.
§eHold 4s, release§r.
Mastered: hold up to 8s longer for +25 damage/+1,500 aura per extra second.
§eSneak+hold§r: dismiss petals.
tensura.skill.flame_breath.description:
Fire breath ahead: 8 damage (16 mastered), sets targets and terrain alight. Costs 30 magicule/s.
§eHold§r to breathe.
tensura.skill.flame_domination.descripti:
Fire abilities ×3 while toggled. Slotted hits burn for 10s (20s mastered).
§eHold§r: fire breath, 8 damage (20 mastered).
§eToggle§r: boost on/off; mastery weakens enemy fire resistance.
tensura.skill.flame_manipulation.descrip:
§bPassive§r: fire abilities +50%.
§eHold§r: breathe fire, 8 damage (20 mastered), sets targets alight.
tensura.skill.flame_transform.descriptio:
Merge with fire: everything within 5 blocks takes 2 damage a second and catches fire. Can light blocks around you.
§eHold§r to keep it up.
tensura.skill.flame_wall.description:
Illusory fire wall, 4 wide and 8 high: 1 damage per 0.5s (0.25s mastered) and slight knockback. Lasts 10s (15s mastered).
§eHold 3s, release§r: place within 10 blocks.
tensura.skill.flare_circle.description:
§eHold§r to cast, then release.
§7Opens a Gate to Hell from which wicked flames erupt to turn your enemies to ash.
tensura.skill.flight.description:
Propels you forward in the air with Slow Falling; up to 10s of flight (15s mastered). Costs 500 magicule per 0.5s, including chanting.
§eHold 3s§r: chant, then keep §eholding§r to fly; §erelease§r to stop.
tensura.skill.float.description:
Levitation I for 10s.
§eHold 2s, release§r.
§6Default§r: lift yourself.
§6Projectile§r (mastered): shoot a sphere for 25 damage and lift its target.
tensura.skill.formhide.description:
Hides your presence (Concealment I) so mobs struggle to notice you. 15 aura.
§eHold§r to stay hidden.
tensura.skill.freeze.description:
Freezes water, hardens lava and upgrades ice; reach 6 blocks.
§6Default§r §ehold 0.5s, release§r: freeze where you aim.
§6Frost Walk§r (mastered) §ehold§r: freeze water and solidify lava underfoot within 5 blocks.
tensura.skill.full_recovery.description:
Fully heals, fills hunger/saturation and grants Absorption IV for 120s (240s mastered). Costs at least 30,000 magicule.
§eHold 6s (4s mastered), release§r: target within 6 blocks, or yourself if none.
tensura.skill.fusionist.description:
Turn blocks into matter, then spend it on explosions.
§6Disassemble§r §epress§r: break the block you aim at (5 blocks). §eSneak+press§r with a block in hand: convert it. Both give matter.
§6Fuse§r §epress§r: mine, 5 matter, 300 damage (500 mastered). Mastered: §epress§r your own mine to grow it (10 matter).
§6Stone§r §epress§r: blast shot, 1 matter, 6-block radius.
tensura.skill.gate.description:
Travel to saved places.
§eHold 15s, release§r: opens the Spatial Movement menu.
§6Warp Points§r: §eSave location§r to remember where you stand; pick one and §eWarp§r (5s charge).
§6Warp Pads§r: travel to warp pads you have placed.
Cost grows with distance.
tensura.skill.giantification.description:
Grows to ×2.5 size: +6 attack damage and +4.5 blocks reach.
§ePress§r to grow.
Mastered: §ehold, scroll, release§r to choose size.
§eSneak+press§r: normal size.
tensura.skill.gluttony.description:
Devouring mist (50 damage, 10 blocks; 15 mastered) that steals skills and EP.
§6Predation§r §epress§r: mist; §esneak+press§r: set Blocks/Fluid/All/None. §6Stomach§r §epress§r: storage. §6Isolation§r §epress§r: remove effects, 200 magicule.
§6Corrosion§r §ehold§r: 10 damage to all within 5. §6Receive§r §epress§r a subordinate: copy its skills.
§6Mimicry§r and §6Provide§r: not implemented.
tensura.skill.godly_craftsman.descriptio:
Engrave enchantments on gear; bonus levels up to +2 over normal.
§ePress§r: spatial storage.
§eSneak+press§r: engraving menu.
Engraving can leave a curse.
tensura.skill.godwolf_sense.description:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Improve your senses to be able to see in the dark or even spot invisible entities nearby.
tensura.skill.gourmand.description:
Your hits can steal EP (50% chance, 75% mastered). Raises max aura and magicule by 3% (7.5% mastered).
§ePress§r to toggle.
§ePress§r a target in reach: eat its heart for EP; it needs Fear (not fully checked).
tensura.skill.gourmet.description:
Eat foes for their skills and EP.
§6Predation§r §epress§r: devouring mist. §esneak+press§r: also eat None/Blocks/Fluid/All.
§6Corrosion§r §ehold§r: hurts all within 5.
§6Stomach§r §epress§r: storage.
§6Receive§r §epress§r on a subordinate: copy its skills.
§6Provide§r: no effect found.
tensura.skill.gravity_attack_nullificati:

§7Completely nullify all gravity damage.
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Ignore weaker gravity-based damage or reduce the damage from stronger attacks.
tensura.skill.gravity_domination.descrip:
Gravity abilities and mace smash damage ×3 while toggled.
§ePress§r: flight on/off; blocked by Magic Interference. 1,000 magicule.
§eToggle§r: boost on/off; mastery weakens enemy gravity resistance.
tensura.skill.gravity_field.description:
Lighter gravity: Speed III and Slow Falling for 60s.

§6Field§r modes §epress§r: a sphere where allies get the same and enemies get Slowness and Burden. §esneak+press§r looking at it: remove.
tensura.skill.gravity_flight.description:
Fly toward where you look; momentum carries on after you let go. 5 magicule.
§eHold§r to fly.

§bPassive§r: gravity abilities +50%, and free flight without holding a key.
§ePress§r to toggle.

Chant speed ×2 and faster learning while on.
§ePress§r to toggle.

§6Refining§r §epress§r: crafting menu. §eSneak+press§r: refining menu.
tensura.skill.greed.description:
Take over minds and force kills.
§6Spiritual Domination§r §ehold§r on a target (30 blocks) to charge control: players 60s, mobs 90s; closer is faster. §eSneak+press§r: release it.
§6Greed Flare§r §epress§r: boost you (+5%) and allies (+2.5%) within 20 blocks. Exact effect not checked.

Allies within 25 blocks get Guarded for 180s: +10 armor and 30 barrier. 100 magicule.

§6Iron Wall§r §epress§r: you gain armor +15 (+40 mastered) and knockback resistance.
tensura.skill.haki.description:
Scares anything under half your EP; far weaker foes die of fear.

§eScroll§r (mastered): Power Scale.

§ePress§r or §ehold§r; toggles once mastered.

Heal by touch or spread Infection (45s).
§6Heal§r §epress§r: heal yourself. §eSneak+press§r: heal a target within 5 blocks. Costs 80 magicule per HP (40 mastered).
§6Infection§r §epress§r at a target: 200 magicule.

tensura.skill.healing.description:
Heals 50 HP; mastered: 100 HP or 25% max HP, whichever is greater. Costs 100 magicule per HP healed, minimum 1,000.
§eHold 3s (1.5s mastered), release§r: target within 6 blocks, or yourself if none.
tensura.skill.healing_rain.description:
Healing rain around you for 5s, 7.5-block radius: heals 10 HP per pulse (20 HP or 5% max HP mastered, whichever is greater). 5,000 magicule.

tensura.skill.healthcare.description:
Regenerates 2 HP every 2s for 500s (5,000s mastered).
§eHold 5s, release§r: apply to yourself.
tensura.skill.heat_nullification.descrip:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Completely negate all heat damage.

§7Ignore weaker heat-based damage or reduce the damage from stronger heat sources.

tensura.skill.heavenly_eye.description:

§7Project your otherworldly gaze to see all nearby entities and partially ignore dodging abilities.
tensura.skill.heavy_slash.description:
Hits your aimed foe within 5 blocks (10 mastered) for ×1.5 attack damage and knockback. Without a target, makes a short ground slash at ×0.5 damage. 80 aura.
§ePress§r.
tensura.skill.hellfire.description:
§eHold§r to cast, then release.
§7Summon a sphere of hellfire to deal massive damage in a small area.
tensura.skill.hero_haki.description:
Fear for 10s on foes under half your EP; larger EP gaps cause stronger Fear.
§eHold§r: sustain the aura, 15 blocks; slows you while held.
§eScroll§r (mastered): Power Scale.
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Completely nullify all holy damage.

§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Ignore weaker holy attacks or reduce the damage from stronger divine powers.
tensura.skill.hydraulic_propulsion.descr:
In water: a fast dash forward, like a Riptide III trident.

Puts a target to sleep for 60s (120s mastered); resistance halves the duration. Costs 2.5% of target EP, minimum 50,000 magicule.

tensura.skill.ice_blizzard.description:
Ice storm around you, 17.5-block radius: 200 damage and Chill, then 80 damage per pulse while sustained. 30,000 magicule.

tensura.skill.ice_breath.description:
Icy breath ahead: 8 damage (16 mastered), builds freezing on targets. Costs 30 magicule/s.
§eHold§r to breathe.
tensura.skill.ice_wall.description:
Ice wall lasts 20s: contact deals 30 damage +Chill I (65 +Chill II mastered); also deals 50 damage each second within 5 blocks. Mastered: releases Frost when removed. 8,000 magicule.
§eHold 3s, release§r: target within 20 blocks.
tensura.skill.icicle_lance.description:
Ice lances: 40 magic damage each.

tensura.skill.icicle_rain.description:
Barrage of ice lances: 60 damage each. 15,000 magicule.

§bPassive§r: always on.

Blink toward your aim: up to 6 blocks (12 mastered). 50 aura.

Cleanses abnormalities and takes over magic.

§eHold§r to cast, then release.

§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Completely nullify all light damage.

§7Ignore weaker light damage or reduce the damage from more powerful attacks.

Speed II and Jump Boost II for 20s (60s mastered).

Lightning strike: 15 damage, 3-block radius. Requires a thunderstorm.

§eToggle§r: lightning abilities ×1.5.

Fire damage ×1.2; hits burn for 10s. 10,000 magicule.

tensura.skill.paralysis_resistance.descr:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Ignore weaker paralysis effects or reduce the duration of stronger paralysis.
tensura.skill.physical_attack_nullificat:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Completely negate all physical damage.
tensura.skill.physical_attack_resistance:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Ignore weaker physical attacks or reduce the damage from stronger blows.
tensura.skill.pierce_nullification.descr:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Completely negate all piercing damage.
tensura.skill.pierce_resistance.descript:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Ignore weaker piercing damage or reduce the damage from stronger attacks.
tensura.skill.poison.description:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Empower your attacks with the effect of Poison, toggleable when mastered.
tensura.skill.poison_nullification.descr:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Completely nullify all poison damage.
tensura.skill.poison_resistance.descript:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Ignore weaker poisons or reduce the damage from more potent toxins.
tensura.skill.poisonous_breath.descripti:
Poison breath ahead: 15 damage (30 mastered) and Fatal Poison I for 10s. Costs 100 magicule/s.
§eHold§r to breathe.
tensura.skill.possession.description:
Take over a weakened body within 6 blocks (a Bone Golem or your clone) and play as it. 100,000 magicule.
§eHold 10s, release§r at the body.
tensura.skill.predator.description:
Devouring mist, 10 damage at 3 blocks.
§6Predation§r §epress§r: mist. §eSneak+press§r: set Blocks/Fluid/All/None.
§6Analysis§r §epress§r: refining menu. §6Stomach§r §epress§r: storage.
§6Isolation§r §epress§r: remove effects, 200 magicule.
§6Mimicry§r: not implemented.
tensura.skill.pride.description:
When a skill or effect hits you, copy it: 20% chance (100% mastered), then a 45s cooldown. Copies become sub-modes.
§6Copy§r §epress§r or §ehold§r uses the selected copy.
§eScroll§r: passed to the copied skill (not checked).
tensura.skill.protection.description:
Protection I adds 20 armor for 120s (600s mastered).
§eHold 5s, release§r: on yourself.
§eSneak+cast§r: on the creature you aim at, within 10 blocks.
tensura.skill.ranged_barrier.description:
Breakable barrier for 60s (120 mastered).
§ePress§r: place within 30 blocks.
§65x5x5 Barrier§r: radius 2.
§610x10x10 Barrier§r: radius 5.
§620x20x20 Barrier§r: radius 10; mastered.
§eSneak+press§r at yours: remove.
tensura.skill.reaper.description:
Small form (×0.5 size): wider Presence Sense, 15% melee and projectile dodge (30 mastered).
§ePress§r to toggle.
§6Attack§r §epress§r: summon clones that copy your stats and skills. §eScroll§r: how many (max 5).
§6Infinite Eater§r §epress§r a target (reach +3): kills it if its EP is lower, steals EP. Toggle off first.
tensura.skill.recovery.description:
Heals up to 50% of max HP. Target players also gain 4 food (8 mastered). Costs 100 magicule per HP healed, minimum 10,000.
§eHold 5s, release§r: heal your target within 6 blocks, or yourself if none.
tensura.skill.reflector.description:
Stores damage you take as echo, then fires it back.
§6Echo Reflection§r §epress§r: piercing echo shot, ×3 damage (×5 mastered). §eSneak+scroll§r: its size.
§6Echo Counter§r: melee hits return ×2.5 damage, projectiles fly back faster. Movement locked until mastered.
tensura.skill.reincarnation.description:
Resets your race and race data, removes race-granted/temporary skills and clears warp points. Keeps 75% of base max aura and magicule. Requires 10,000 magicule.
§eHold 10s, release§r: reset and open reincarnation menu.
tensura.skill.reinforced_barrier.descrip:
HP-scaled damage barriers. Costs 5% of max magicule, minimum 5,000.
§eHold 8s, release§r.
§6Combined Barrier§r: magic and physical defense for 30s.
Mastered: §6Magic Defense§r or §6Physical Defense§r: stronger single-type barrier for 15s.
tensura.skill.reinforcement.description:
Reinforcement III reduces gear durability loss for 120s (600s mastered).
§eHold 5s, release§r: on yourself.
§eSneak+cast§r: on the creature you aim at, within 10 blocks.
tensura.skill.researcher.description:
Engrave enchantments on gear; bonus levels up to +1.
§ePress§r: spatial storage.
§eSneak+press§r: engraving menu.
Engraving can leave a curse.
tensura.skill.reverser.description:
Flip things to their opposite.
§6Alignment Reverse§r §epress§r at a target within 3 blocks: flip chaos/order.
§6Inverted Fusion§r Buff: target's buffs become debuffs. Debuff: debuffs become buffs. §ePress§r.
Mastered: toggle to turn your debuffs into buffs; §epress§r an item to reverse curses (10,000 magicule).
tensura.skill.roaring_lion_punch.descrip:
Punch: attack damage +1 per 10 aura spent. Uses 10% of max aura, capped at 2,000 (4,000 mastered).
§ePress§r at a foe with an empty hand or fist weapon.
tensura.skill.royal_beast.description:
Beast form for 180s (360 mastered): massive physical boost, health set to full. 60s cooldown.
§ePress§r to transform.
tensura.skill.sacred_haki.description:
Fears foes under half your EP; heals allies 60 HP every 5s and clears harmful effects.
§6Magicule Release§r §ehold§r: aura, 15 blocks.
§6Magicule Coat§r §epress§r: Haki Coat for 120s; again to end.
§eScroll§r in Release (mastered): Power Scale.
tensura.skill.sage.description:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Increase the speed at which you learn and master skills, magic and arts.
tensura.skill.scale_armor.description:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Like the lizardmen, move through water and mud with no penalties while receiving a slight defense buff.
tensura.skill.search_enemy.description:
Highlights nearby hostile mobs.
§eHold 2s, release§r: lasts 120s; §epress§r again to end.
§6Constant§r: §ehold§r for 2s, then keep holding to maintain it for 5 magicule per second.
tensura.skill.seeker.description:
§bPassive§r while toggled on; §epress§r to toggle.
§7Accelerate thought processing to extreme levels, mastery over magics and manipulate the fundamental laws governing the world to optimize actions and outcomes.
tensura.skill.seer.description:
§bPassive§r while toggled on; §epress§r to toggle.
§7See everything. Foresee your opponent’s moves. Dodge or mitigate their attacks and predict their movement to score critical strikes.
tensura.skill.self_regeneration.descript:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Speed up your body’s natural regeneration to increase your survivability.
tensura.skill.sense_heat_source.descript:
§bPassive§r: highlights warm-bodied creatures within 20 blocks.
§ePress§r to toggle.
tensura.skill.sense_soundwave.descriptio:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Empower your ears to precisely locate any nearby entities.
tensura.skill.severer.description:
§ePress§r to use.
§6Modes§r: Dummy Sword, Blade Storm, Severance.
§7Slice through reality and manifest spatial blades which cut through armor and unleash devastating blade storms.
tensura.skill.shadow_bind.description:
§eHold§r to cast, then release.
§7If the target is standing in shadows, bind them and deal spiritual damage.
tensura.skill.shadow_motion.description:
§6Default§r §ehold§r: sink into the shadows and move unseen.
§6Shadow Step§r §epress§r: jump through shadows up to 20 blocks.
§6Shadow Storage§r §epress§r at a subordinate: keep it in your shadow so it travels with you.
tensura.skill.shadow_striker.description:
§bPassive§r while toggled on; §epress§r to toggle.
§6Modes§r: Ultra Acceleration, Insta-kill, Espionage.
§7Become one with the shadows and deal massive spiritual damage and become immune to lesser presence detection.
tensura.skill.shrink.description:
Shrink to 20% size for 60s (120 mastered): much harder to hit, but Fragility V (III mastered) makes hits hurt more.
§eHold 3s, release§r.
tensura.skill.sleep_mist.description:
Sleeping mist around you: 5-block radius, Paralysis II. Cloud lasts 15s (25s mastered). 5,000 magicule.
§eHold 5s, release§r.
tensura.skill.sloth.description:
§bPassive§r while toggled on; §epress§r to toggle.
§6Modes§r: Deep Hypno, Fallen Hypno, Deprive, Rest, Phantasmal Style, Fallen Strike.
§7Grind the world to a halt. Put your enemies into a deadly sleep, drain their power and rest to regain any lost vitality. May lethargy take over.
tensura.skill.snake_eye.description:
Builds a debuff on the foe you watch, up to 20 blocks. 80 magicule/s.
§eHold§r to apply the selected effect:
§6Corrosion§r, §6Poison§r (Fatal Poison), §6Paralysis§r, §6Petrification§r or §6Insanity§r.
tensura.skill.sniper.description:
§bPassive§r: dodge chance, better Presence Sense, stronger ranged attacks.
§6Create Weapon§r and §6Spatial Manipulation§r modes: §epress§r. Their exact effects are not checked.
tensura.skill.solar_beam.description:
§eHold§r to cast, then release.
§7Fire a light beam that deals massive damage to undead entities and burns blocks.
tensura.skill.solar_flare.description:
§eHold§r to cast, then release.
§7Shoot a shockwave of light energy to give nausea, blindness and slowness to all targets in a wide AOE.
tensura.skill.solar_rain.description:
§eHold§r to cast, then release.
§7Shoot many light projectiles that deal massive damage to undead creatures.
tensura.skill.solar_wave.description:
§eHold§r to cast, then release.
§7Shoot a wave of light energy that blinds and slows hit enemies.
tensura.skill.sound_domination.descripti:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Boosts Sound abilities by a large amount.
tensura.skill.sound_manipulation.descrip:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Boosts Sound abilities by a decent amount.
tensura.skill.space.description:
Makes an invisible platform you can stand on, up to 4 blocks away, for 60s.
§eHold 1s, release§r where you want the foothold.
tensura.skill.space_transform.descriptio:
Deals 2 space damage to creatures within 5 blocks and gives Weakness I for 8s. Slows your movement while active.
§eHold§r to keep it up.
tensura.skill.spatial_attack_nullificati:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Completely nullify all spatial damage.
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Ignore weaker spatial attacks or reduce the damage from stronger dimensional strikes.
tensura.skill.spatial_domination.descrip:
§bPassive§r: space abilities ×3 (toggle).
§6Warp Shot§r §epress§r: toggle shot warping.
§6Spatial Cleanse§r §epress§r: remove Severance; §esneak+press§r: target within 5.
§6Dimension Ray§r §ehold§r: 30-block beam, 50 damage (200 mastered).
§6Dimension Storm§r §epress§r: 20 rays (30 mastered), 50 damage (100); 50,000 magicule.
§6Fault Field§r §ehold§r: magicule blocks most hits.
tensura.skill.spatial_manipulation.descr:
§bPassive§r: space abilities +50%.
§6Warp Shot§r §epress§r: your shots warp through space.
tensura.skill.spatial_motion.description:
Teleport to aimed or saved places; cost grows with distance.
§6Blink§r §epress§r: jump up to 30 blocks (50 mastered).
§6Warp§r §epress§r: open travel menu; choose a saved place or warp pad. 5s travel charge (instant mastered).
tensura.skill.spatial_storage.descriptio:
Pocket storage: 54 slots, stacks of 100 (200 mastered).
§eHold 2s, release§r.
§6Spatial Bag§r: creates a bag; mastered: opens storage directly, §esneak+cast§r makes a bag.
§6Dress Change§r (mastered): swaps worn armor with stored armor.
tensura.skill.spearhead.description:
§ePress§r to use.
§7Empower and command your allies, and then collect their abilities once they pass on.
tensura.skill.spiritual_attack_nullifica:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Completely negate all spiritual damage.
tensura.skill.spiritual_attack_resistanc:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Ignore weaker spiritual attacks or resist stronger ones.
tensura.skill.starved.description:
§bPassive§r while toggled on; §epress§r to toggle.
§6Modes§r: Corrosion, Provide, Receive, Stomach.
§7Consume all in your path or have your rampaging subordinates do it. Corrode your enemies, devour their strength, and adding their abilities to your own.
tensura.skill.steel_strength.description:
Strengthen III for 30s (IV for 90s mastered): more damage.
§ePress§r; toggles once mastered.
tensura.skill.sticky_steel_thread.descri:
Web shots, grappling and magical restraints.
§6Sticky§r / §6Steel§r §epress§r: fire webs.
§6Slinger§r §epress§r: grapple; §esneak+press§r: detach.
§6Arcane Thread Fetters§r §epress§r: Silence for 25s; also Webbed if target EP ≤ yours. Range 10 (20 mastered). Press again within 5s (10 mastered): release for 30 damage (60).
tensura.skill.stone_shot.description:
Three rock spikes: 150 damage plus 50 earth each. 45,000 magicule.
§eHold 4s, release§r.
§6Chain§r: one after another. §6Spread§r: in a fan.
tensura.skill.strength.description:
Strengthen II for 60s (III, 2 min mastered).
§ePress§r; toggles once mastered.
tensura.skill.strengthen_body.descriptio:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Strengthen your body to better protect yourself against attacks.
tensura.skill.summon_basilisk.descriptio:
§eHold§r to cast, then release.
§7Summon a Basilisk to temporarily fight for you.
tensura.skill.summon_daemon.description:
§eHold§r to cast, then release.
§7Summon a Daemon from hell to fight for you.
tensura.skill.summon_greater_elemental.d:
Calls your contracted greater spirit to fight beside you for 30s. Cooldown 10 min (5 mastered).
§eHold 5s (3s mastered), release§r.
tensura.skill.summon_hound_dog.descripti:
§eHold§r to cast, then release.
§7Summon a Hound Dog to temporarily fight for you.
tensura.skill.summon_medium_elemental.de:
Calls your contracted spirit to fight beside you for 30s. Cooldown 10 min (5 mastered).
§eHold 5s (3s mastered), release§r.
tensura.skill.summon_otherworlder.descri:
§eHold§r to cast, then release.
§7Summon a human from a different world.
tensura.skill.suppressor.description:
§bPassive§r while toggled on; §epress§r to toggle.
§6Modes§r: Spatial Suppression, Swap, Spatial Motion.
§7Restrict teleportation, confuse enemies by swapping places, and use your blink as well as the spatial gate to cross large distances.
tensura.skill.survivor.description:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Endure and outheal anything, resist physical and natural damage and withstand overwhelming odds.
tensura.skill.swipe.description:
§eHold§r to cast, then release.
§7Slashing through space in a straight line, displacing entities or teleporting the caster.
tensura.skill.telepathy.description:
Give orders to a tamed creature or follower.
§ePress§r while looking at it.
tensura.skill.teleport.description:
Blink to where you are looking, up to 30 blocks (50 mastered). Cooldown 20s (10 mastered).
§eHold briefly, release§r.
tensura.skill.thermal_fluctuation_nullif:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Completely negate all thermal damage.
tensura.skill.thermal_fluctuation_resist:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Ignore weaker thermal damage regardless of its type or resist stronger attacks.
tensura.skill.thought_acceleration.descr:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Increase the speed at which you think to cast magic more quickly as well as to increase your reaction speed.
tensura.skill.thought_communication.desc:
Orders for your followers within 30 blocks.
§6Movement§r §epress§r at a follower: follow / stay.
§6Targeting§r §epress§r at a foe: attack it.
§eSneak§r: order all followers at once.
tensura.skill.thrower.description:
§ePress§r to use.
§7Use your skill and your precision to throw anything and deal massive damage. You can even shove air or push back your foes.
tensura.skill.thunder.description:
Lightning where you aim, up to 30 blocks away: 100 damage in a 3-block radius (200 damage, 5 blocks mastered). 30,000 magicule.
§eHold 1s, release§r.
tensura.skill.thunder_breath.description:
Lightning breath ahead: 10 damage (20 mastered). Costs 50 magicule/s.
§eHold§r to breathe.
tensura.skill.thunder_lance.description:
Lightning lances; 5,000 magicule.
§eHold 4s, release§r.
§6Single§r: one lance, 50 damage plus 30 lightning.
§6Rain§r (mastered): a barrage, 30 damage plus 30 lightning each.
tensura.skill.thunder_orb.description:
Fires a thunder orb that strikes nearby enemies every 0.5s: 80 damage plus 40 lightning, 5-block radius (10 mastered). 20,000 magicule.
§eHold 6s (4s mastered), release§r.
tensura.skill.thunder_rain.description:
Lightning storm or charged hits; 70,000 magicule.
§eHold 8s (5s mastered), release§r.
§6Rain§r: storm follows you, 17.5-block radius; 300 damage every 4s for 30s.
§6Coating§r (mastered): next five physical hits add 100 lightning damage.
tensura.skill.titanification.description:
Grows to ×4 size for 6s: +60 attack damage, +20 armor and longer reach; resists magic.
§ePress§r to grow.
Mastered: §ehold, scroll, release§r to choose size.
§eSneak+press§r: end it.
tensura.skill.tornado_blade.description:
Wind sphere: 150 damage plus 25 wind (300 plus 50 mastered). Mastered: pulls foes and bursts into ten blades, 50 damage each. 40,000 magicule.
§eHold 2.5s, release§r.
tensura.skill.traveler.description:
§bPassive§r while toggled on; §epress§r to toggle.
§6Modes§r: Instant Motion, Teleport, Spatial Manipulation, Stardust Arrow, Stardust Rain.
§7Move freely through space, teleport large distances or create spatial gates. Manipulate stardust to immense damage.
tensura.skill.true_darkness.description:
§eHold§r to cast, then release.
§7Inflict Blindness on all entities and deal massive spiritual damage.
tensura.skill.tuner.description:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Change your fate survive fatal blows, regenerate instantly and manipulate probability.
tensura.skill.ultra_instinct.description:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Enhance your sense to dodge physical impact.
tensura.skill.ultrasonic_waves.descripti:
§6Sonic Boom§r §epress§r: blast 8 blocks ahead, 8 damage.
§6Auditory Sense§r §epress§r: see nearby creatures through walls for 10s.
tensura.skill.ultraspeed_regeneration.de:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Boost your bodies healing to nearly impossible levels
tensura.skill.universal_perception.descr:
§bPassive§r: senses creatures within 20 blocks by magic, sound and heat.
§ePress§r to toggle.
tensura.skill.unpredictability.descripti:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7In the hands of a True Hero, unpredictability reigns supreme. The Hero sees all, becoming able to ignore dodge and even read the movements of their opponent to disable their critical attacks or their dodge avoidance.
tensura.skill.unyielding.description:
§ePress§r to use.
§6Modes§r: Default, Backup.
§7Draw power from loyal allies. Fortify subordinates and seamlessly switch to a backup body to stay in the fight.
tensura.skill.usurper.description:
§ePress§r to use.
§6Modes§r: Rob, Copy, Force Takeover.
§7Seize your enemies' power or their summons. Steal their abilities and take control of their skills, draining their strength for your own.
tensura.skill.villain.description:
§bPassive§r while toggled on; §epress§r to toggle.
§6Modes§r: Demon Lord's Haki, Villain's Charisma.
§7Embody malice and fight on the side of evil. Gain increased power from killing your foes, manipulate your enemies into joining your side and empower your allies.
tensura.skill.violent_break.description:
Strengthen I (II mastered) for 60s; removes one level of configured harmful effects, including Bad Omen and Nausea. 150 aura.
§eHold 3s§r to activate.
tensura.skill.voice_cannon.description:
Sound blast in a line, 15 blocks (20 mastered): 20 damage (30) and Silence.
§ePress§r.
tensura.skill.warp_portal.description:
§eHold§r to cast, then release.
§7Tear space asunder connecting two points in space.
tensura.skill.water.description:
Creates water, up to 4 blocks away; also fills cauldrons.
§eHold 1s, release§r. Modes set the size (1×1 up to 10×10).
tensura.skill.water_attack_nullification:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Completely nullify all water damage.
tensura.skill.water_attack_resistance.de:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Ignore weaker water-based damage or reduce the damage from stronger attacks.
tensura.skill.water_blade.description:
A fast blade of water: 40 damage. Uses 1 point of water (Gourmet's Stomach water works).
§ePress§r.
tensura.skill.water_breathing.descriptio:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Remove the requirement of air underwater.
tensura.skill.water_current_control.desc:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Manipulate water around you to propel yourself in any direction.
tensura.skill.water_cutter.description:
A cutting blade of water: 40 damage plus 30.
§eHold 1.5s, release§r. §6Repeat§r mode keeps firing while held.
tensura.skill.water_domination.descripti:
§bPassive§r: water abilities ×3; toggle on/off.
§eHold§r: water breath, 8 damage (4 mastered).
§eSneak+press§r: water ball, 12 damage.
Both need water nearby or stored water points.
tensura.skill.water_jail.description:
§eHold§r to cast, then release.
§7Surround targets with flows of water.
tensura.skill.water_manipulation.descrip:
§bPassive§r: water abilities +50%.
§eHold§r: water breath, 8 damage.
§eSneak+press§r: water ball, 12 damage.
Both need water nearby or stored water.
tensura.skill.water_transform.descriptio:
Merge with water: everything within 5 blocks takes 2 damage a second and is Poisoned.
§eHold§r to keep it up.
tensura.skill.weather_domination.descrip:
Sets Overworld weather for 1,200s. 500 magicule.
§ePress§r in §6Clear Weather§r, §6Rain§r or §6Thunder Storm§r to set that weather; works under cover too.
tensura.skill.weather_manipulation.descr:
Sets Overworld weather for 600s. 1,000 magicule.
§ePress§r under open sky in §6Clear Weather§r, §6Rain§r or §6Thunder Storm§r to set that weather.
tensura.skill.wind.description:
§eHold§r to cast, then release.
§7Call forth a small gust of wind which can push targets away or the player up.
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Completely nullify all wind damage.
tensura.skill.wind_attack_resistance.des:
§bPassive§r: always on.
§7Ignore weaker wind damage or reduce the damage from stronger attacks.
tensura.skill.wind_blade.description:
§eHold§r to cast, then release.
§7Fires a concentrated blade of wind which has heavy knockback.
tensura.skill.wind_cutter.description:
Blades of wind: 30 damage plus 10.
§eHold 2s, release§r.
tensura.skill.wind_domination.descriptio:
§bPassive§r: wind abilities ×3; toggle on/off.
§eHold§r: wind breath, 8 damage (4 mastered); puts out your fire.
§eSneak+press§r: wind sphere, 12 damage and strong knockback.
tensura.skill.wind_gust.description:
A strong gust that shoves things away.
§eHold 1s, release§r.
tensura.skill.wind_manipulation.descript:
§bPassive§r: wind abilities ×1.5; toggle on/off.
§eHold§r: wind breath, 8 damage (4 mastered); puts out your fire.
§eSneak+press§r: wind sphere, 12 damage and strong knockback.
tensura.skill.wind_protection.descriptio:
§eHold§r to cast, then release.
§7Call forth flows of wind to coat the caster with speed and protection.
tensura.skill.wind_transform.description:
Wind deals 2 damage to creatures within 5 blocks and gives Paralysis I for 8s. Slows your movement while active.
§eHold§r to keep it up.
tensura.skill.wrath.description:
§bPassive§r effect. §eHold§r to use it actively; toggles once mastered.
§6Modes§r: Breeder Reactor, Enrage.
§7Unleash pure rage and use it to get infinitely stronger the longer your anger persists. Beware of the devastating drawback.
